shortIntro.title: Smooth Standoff Mobile Gameplay Starts with the Right Device 🎯
shortIntro.para1: Standoff Mobile is a fast-action tactical shooter featuring realistic maps, flashy weapon skins, and intense PvP battles. Its high-resolution textures, particle effects, and dynamic lighting demand a capable CPU and GPU for smooth combat.
shortIntro.para2: Quick aiming, rapid shooting, and stable multiplayer battles depend on your device’s processing power, refresh rate, and cooling. High-tier devices ensure crisp visuals, fast load times, and almost zero lag during firefights.

faqIntroText: Common questions about Standoff Mobile performance, graphics, and device compatibility ❓:

faqList.question: Is Standoff Mobile heavy on my phone?
faqList.answer: Yes. HD textures, maps, and visual effects require a strong GPU and sufficient RAM.

faqList.question: Can I run 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, but only mid-range or high-end devices with sufficient GPU and RAM can maintain stable 60 FPS.

faqList.question: Why does my device heat up during gameplay?
faqList.answer: Fast rendering, online battles, and effects generate heat, especially on lower-tier devices.

faqList.question: Can I play with low storage?
faqList.answer: Not recommended. Less than 4–5GB free space may cause lag or stuttering.
